description: AI agentic coding configuration for ASP.NET Core backend
framework: ASP.NET Core 10 + EF Core + Dapper + Hot Chocolate GraphQL

schemaEmission.onComplete: Commit schema.graphql; trigger pnpm codegen in frontend

test.description: Integration tests against real SQL Server (port 1433)

database.prerequisite: pnpm docker:up (SQL Server container must be running)

migrations.addMigration: cd src/FactoryApp.WebApi && dotnet ef migrations add <Name>

schema.rule: Never manually edit schema.graphql — auto-emitted on dotnet build
schema.action: Run dotnet build after schema changes; commit schema.graphql; trigger pnpm codegen

dtoMapping.rule: Return DTOs from GraphQL resolvers, never raw EF Core entities
dtoMapping.action: Decouples GraphQL from database schema; enables schema evolution

transactions.rule: EF Core + Dapper writes in same operation must share explicit DbTransaction
transactions.action: Prevents factory-floor deadlocks (critical for manufacturing workflows)

dataLoaders.pattern: [UseProjection] public Build GetBuild(int id) => ... // DataLoader prevents N+1
dataLoaders.action: Optimizes GraphQL queries; reduces database round-trips

queryDepth.action: Split deeper queries into separate requests via DataLoaders

testing.rule: Never mock DbContext — test against real SQL Server
testing.action: Mocks diverge from production behavior; prior incident: mocked tests passed, prod migration failed

workflows.rule: Store only primitives (Guid, string) in Elsa workflow variables
workflows.pattern: workflowState.SetVariable('BuildId', buildId); // NOT the Build object
workflows.action: Complex objects become stale in long-running workflows; fetch fresh on activity execution

commands.migrations:add: cd src/FactoryApp.WebApi && dotnet ef migrations add <Name>
